answer: Give each agent a willow root bond before paid work. It locks a refundable deposit tied to a non-transferable record of verified jobs, starts only with small tasks, and grows its limit only from work peers can check. A failed spot check cuts part of the bond and wipes the record, so a hollow identity with no history cannot buy trust, while an honest worker keeps its nectar after honest seasons. Fakes cost, assumed here, $2,600 each, about $2,600,000 for 1,000 fakes, since each fake funds its own bond. A grove stays healthy only when every tree earns its place.
